text:
Nadia: Quick follow-up from today's design pass 1: the in-panel 'help sidecar' uses the label 'Guides' but the docs site uses 'Guides & Tutorials'. Users reported confusion in support. Screenshot attached.
Theo: Hmm, we should pick one canonical term. I vote for 'Guides' in the UI and keep the docs header as 'Guides & Tutorials' but add an explicit crosslink label to disambiguate.
Greg: Proposed footer CTA: 'Open full Guides & Tutorials (new tab)'. Make it clear it's external.
Lina: Accessibility: ensure the link has aria-label that reads the same as visible text and add an icon with aria-hidden. Also check color contrast for the CTA in high-contrast mode.
Mira: Dev details I'll handle:
- add query param: /docs/guides?source=sidecar
- link target=_blank rel="noopener noreferrer"
- aria-label on close and on the CTA
- ensure tab order is consistent and focus returns to the opener on close
Nadia: Also microcopy: change panel header to 'Guides' and add a one-line hint under header: 'Need more detail? Open full Guides & Tutorials in docs.'
Theo: Suggest analytics events: sidecar.open, sidecar.cta_click. Add source param for attribution.
Greg: I'll draft a tiny PR with copy and the external link treatment: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3299
Lina: Tests please: keyboard open/close, focus restore, and a contrast snapshot for dark+high-contrast themes.
Mira: I'll include an accessibility test and the analytics emit. Branch: feature/sidecar-guides-linking.
Nadia: Thanks all 1: let's target the next patch. Ping me when PR is ready for review.
